description: This Java source file defines the class 'TaxAuthorityServices', which provides various services and utilities for tax calculation within the OFBiz framework, specifically handling tax adjustments, product tax rates, and tax exemptions based on geographic and party information.

classes.name: TaxAuthorityServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for calculating tax rates, adjustments, and handling tax exemptions within the OFBiz framework related to tax authorities, products, and geographic regions.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalcForDisplay
methods.description: Calculates and returns the tax total, percentage, and price with tax for a product for display purposes, taking into account store settings and tax adjustments.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates the applicable tax adjustments for a list of products and returns the adjustments, considering store settings, geographic location, and party details.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Gathers relevant tax authorities based on the geographic address, expanding regions as needed.

methods.name: getTaxAdjustments
methods.description: Generates tax adjustment records based on product, store, party, and tax authorities, considering various conditions such as shipping, promotions, and product category.

methods.name: setProductCategoryCond
methods.description: Creates an EntityCondition for product categories related to a given product.

methods.name: handlePartyTaxExempt
methods.description: Checks and applies tax exemption rules for a party, based on party relationships and tax exemption status.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Retrieves product price details for a specific product, store, and tax authority, considering product store groups and purchase purpose.
